height.invalid: Invalid height correction: {errors} errors; {zones} zones, {points} effective points (limit {zoneLimit} zones / {pointLimit} points).
height.limit: Height correction exceeds the limit: {zones} zones, {points} effective points (limit {zoneLimit} zones / {pointLimit} points).
height.inspection-limit: Height correction could not be fully inspected: {rawZones} raw zones exceed the inspection budget {inspectionLimit}; inspected: {zones} effective zones, {points} points. The inspection budget is not a content zone/point limit.
height.repair: Nothing applied. Repair the file manually or via Git; do not write back a truncated copy.
lock.applied: Applied, but {count} object(s) stay locked in place: their deletion is held back and survives every restart. Confirm to delete them (POST /api/welt/bestaetigen with the current hash).
lock.open: {count} object(s) are permanently locked; their deletion survives every restart (confirm: POST /api/welt/bestaetigen with the current hash).
lock.pending: The reconcile would have removed many objects or objects with state; nothing happened live. The affected objects are permanently locked and stay in place across restarts until the deletion is explicitly confirmed (POST /api/welt/bestaetigen with the current hash; details in `detail`).
confirm.no-hash: hash (the held-back state) is missing or empty — nothing changed.
confirm.nothing-open: No held-back deletion is open — nothing to confirm.
confirm.lock-unreadable: The deletion lock file exists but is unreadable — check it by hand. Nothing confirmed.
confirm.stale: The world file has changed since the deletion was held back (now {current}) — nothing applied. Reload and check again.
confirm.write-failed: Confirmation request could not be written: {reason}
confirm.server-off: Confirmation request written, but the game server is not running — it takes effect at the next start.
confirm.rejected: The confirmation was not carried out ({reason}) — nothing deleted.
confirm.done-rest-pending: Held-back deletion carried out; the rest of the document is not applied yet.
confirm.pending: Confirmation request written but not applied yet — the guard picks it up at the next tick.
vegetation.abgelehnt: Vegetation not cleared: {kreise} circle(s) with {objekte} objects over the limit — takes effect after the next restart.
vegetation.ungemarkt: Vegetation: {anzahl} object(s) in {zonen} zone(s) without an origin mark not cleared.
